name: Maule Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

known.via: English Wikipedia "Maule Valley" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: Varied microclimates suit red and white, and it is best known for powerful reds. Cabernet Sauvignon covers 28 percent of vines.
